## Welcome to Greenwood Memorial Park

Located in the shadow of the Fort Worth Cultural District, Greenwood Memorial Park is in its own right a beautiful masterpiece, and a tribute to the creation's own work of art and beauty. With more than a century of service to families in the Greater Fort Worth area, this historic perpetual care cemetery guards the memory of many a Texas legend, with names that are immediately known around the world.

Each year, thousands of visitors enter these sacred grounds through an entrance that features one of the city's most dynamic outdoor works of art, The Quadriga. Four magnificent life-size bronze horses statues can be seen striding four abreast as a symbol of victory. The Quadriga is considered to be among the greatest replicas in the world of the Four Horses from St. Mark's Basilica in Venice. Each guest to the cemetery is gently drawn by the love and memories of those whose remains are concealed here, but whose memories will be forever preserved. With more than 190 acres, this tree-filled green oasis also stands as a monument to a city's past but also endures as a harbinger of faith, hope, and love for now...and for all time.

Owned by the not-for-profit Mount Olivet Cemetery Association, Greenwood Memorial Park is also home to Greenwood Funeral Homes and Cremation's - Greenwood Chapel, and the beautiful Greenwood Mausoleum.

## Greenwood Mausoleum

Designed by renowned American architect, Harwell Hamilton Harris, Greenwood Mausoleum opened in June 1961, and soon after, it was recognized by the Texas Society of Architects with an award of honor for its quality of design. Located within the mausoleum are a number of inner chambers, each with its own unique personality -- produced by the use of a fusion of Italian Carrara Marble, connecting hallways, and covered and uncovered courtyards. The center open courtyard features a striking bronze fountain created by noted artist, Wilber Verhelst.

Located at the West end of the mausoleum is Independence Chapel, designed to seat both small and large gatherings. The chapel interior features eight life-size statues of the United States' founding patriots and a 12-foot mosaic of the Great Seal of the United States. The Mausoleum has the ability to serve tens of thousands of entombments. Below the chapel level, is the Westminster section of the mausoleum. This unique section of the mausoleum provides the most economical arrangement for casket and cremated entombment within a world-class mausoleum.

## WELCOME

Since 1907, our mission of service has never changed,

"To provide every family the highest level of professional care and dignity as they

Gather, Honor, Reflect, and Remember."

Greenwood Funeral Homes and Cremation, Greenwood Memorial Park, and Mount Olivet Cemetery are the perfect settings for families and friends to celebrate the life of someone they love; but also to begin the healing process as they draw needed strength from each other, share stories, express love, and most importantly remember...together.

For more than a century, our Funeral Homes, Cemeteries, Mausoleums, Crematory, and Flower Shops have built a national reputation for award-winning facilities. But as important as it is to have beautiful places of honor, it is of most importance to have dedicated, honorable, and compassionate people with a heart for service. We are fortunate to have both. Our exceptional amenities and professional staff work together to encourage, comfort, and guide families through life's most difficult times.

Thank you for visiting our website today. We invite you to look around and hopefully see why so many families in the Greater Fort Worth area have placed their trust in us. We also welcome you to call or visit any of our locations and speak with one of our Family Service or Advance Planning Representatives. See for yourself the legacy of care that has made our funeral homes, mausoleums, cemeteries, and mausoleums among our nation's most --

Beautiful places ... to Remember.
